description: Truncated DOCX (valid ZIP local header, missing central directory) should fail cleanly at detect/select instead of crashing.
notes: Broken-but-PK zips are rejected during detect/select, so the message is the generic 'Unsupported input' rather than the converter-level 'Failed to open DOCX file as ZIP archive'. The case pins the clean-exit contract; improving the wording is a separate diagnostics task.
